quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign warns drivers not to block the intersection when traffic is stopped.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and shaped like diamonds. They alert drivers to dangers ahead. This sign warns that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with the flow of traffic.
Slow down for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum speed allowed on that road.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Keep your speed the same until you reach the reduced speed zone.
Do not slow down because traffic will back up.
You may slow down if you want to.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to start slowing down. The new speed limit will begin at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about construction zones. This sign tells you to take a different route around roadwork.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means the divided highway is ending soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for red lights, yellow lights, and other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes of opposite traffic are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not go if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Do not drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What is this sign warning you about?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This chevron sign shows that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. There may be several of these signs along the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you that a steep hill is coming and you should be ready to change your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards. This sign warns you that farm machinery may be in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that shows rules you must obey. Where this sign is posted, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that a yield sign is coming up. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or turns, and stay farther back from other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign shows that there are multiple lanes where you can turn left. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that the normal driving route is closed. You should expect to follow a different route ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you when and how long you can park. You can park for a maximum of two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means you cannot turn left at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This regulation sign forbids passing other vehicles. You must obey it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you there is a stop sign coming ahead. Prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road curves right and then left. Slow down to safely turn through these curves.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the highest legal speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather like rain, snow, or ice, drive slower than this speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Merging traffic is approaching from the left.
Right lane ends ahead, merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends ahead, merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending. Move to the left lane ahead of time.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers that right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with a yellow background and black markings. It warns you that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with a yellow background and black markings. It warns you that the shoulder is lower than the paved road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with a yellow background and black markings. It tells you that a detour is 1,000 feet ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with a yellow background and black markings. It warns you that a crossroad or intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead is divided by a median or divider. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic lights, red is always at the top and green is always at the bottom. On horizontal lights, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.

questions.question: What do these signs indicate?
questions.explanation: These are object marker warning signs with yellow and black markings. They warn you about dangerous objects or areas that you should avoid.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This marks a High Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and cars with the required number of passengers can use this lane, as shown on the sign.
